summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str() of objects with sep, delegates once to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow="ignore", crop off; highlight defaults to True). Added a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after Logging, an "Added Console.out" bullet under Unreleased/Added in CHANGELOG.md, and test_out_* tests in tests/test_console.py after test_print_style. Nothing was committed and no tests were run, per instructions, so the new tests are unverified. The highlight tests depend on the first renderable a render hook sees carrying the highlighter spans; if that assumption is wrong they will fail and need adjusting.
